Had this exact problem yesterday using the ingest pipeline with a return statement. One of my nodes crashed, a few hours later recovered (I'm using elastic cloud).

**Elasticsearch**:
"version" : "7.10.1", "build_flavor" : "default", "build_type" : "docker"

**Plugins installed**: []

**JVM**:
"version" : "15.0.1"

**OS** : 
"CentOS Linux 8 (Core)", "arch" : "amd64", "version" : "4.15.0-1039-aws",    "available_processors" : 2,"allocated_processors" : 2

I was able to replicate this. This will happen anytime a `def` type value is explicitly returned where the context has a `void` type return.

Another note: this does not appear to be related to any of the recent refactoring.

issue.title: Remove leniency for casting from def to void in Painless

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body: This leniency was originally for lambda and method reference conversions, but they are both special cased now. This removes change removes the unnecessary leniency of a cast from a `def` type to a `void` type. This also fixes (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/66175).
